span.p:
confirmed / rejected / partial
三者都进 Act, 不从 Check 退回

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch1 回顾实验
读 task.json meta.scenario_type
development/bugfix: 测试已跑吗? 新测试真实覆盖吗?
research/doc/design/review: 对照PRD验收+产出物检查
+ evidence/manifest.jsonl 证据清单核对

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch2 Grill 可靠性
grilling 双轴追问(结论+证据)
场景感知问题:
dev: 测试证明行为还是实现细节? 边界/并发/恢复?
research: 方法充分? 遗漏关键来源? 替代解释?
模糊术语→更新 CONTEXT.md
不清晰的继续 Grilling

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch3 验证收敛
meta.convergence → AC → evidence 全覆盖
AC 无证据→结论降级(标注部分成立)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch4 结论文档 + 判定
write-conclusion:
records//conclusion.md
章节: 上下文/假设与结果/分析
/失败原因(rejected|partial)/适用边界
/下一轮建议/已知坑
+ task.json meta.verdict:
outcome + reason + verdict_id + at
verdict_id 唯一(历史 T-confirmed-)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch5 用户判定
展示结论摘要
confirmed → Act 知识沉淀+归档
rejected → Act 失败处置(不沉淀)
partial → Act 提取有效部分+跟进
判定后追加 clarifications.jsonl
source: check_confirmation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ch6 推进
advance-phase check→act
meta.record 写入结论引用
门禁: check→act 需 conclusion + verdict
+ check_confirmation
